intro: Change is constant. Convergence observes and classifies how the relationship between a company's price behavior and its financial-structure behavior shifts over time — not prediction.
state_label_note: Labels such as Central Agreement, High Agreement, Unresolved, and similar describe the framework's relationship-identity classification at a point in time — not buy/sell or valuation judgments.

metric_definitions.yes_rate: Yes-rate: the share of independent comparison units in which the stated structural pattern was detected in the ~12-month follow-up window — not a return or performance measure.
metric_definitions.n: n: the number of independent comparison units scored in that validation run — each unit pairs two companies on the same date under fixed pre-scoring rules.
metric_definitions.verdict_confirmed: Confirmed: the pattern occurred above the 50% coin-flip baseline with trust-bar strata met.
metric_definitions.verdict_falsified: Falsified: the pattern did not occur above the 50% coin-flip baseline with trust-bar strata met.
metric_definitions.spell_age: Spell age (Library 2-R): how long a company has remained in its current observed structural state relative to the point-in-time median time that state typically took to resolve historically.
